job.job_description:
Join our AI team as a Senior LLM Engineer and work at the cutting edge of natural language processing fine-tuning large language models, designing prompt strategies, and deploying production NLP systems.

Fine-tune transformer-based models (GPT, BERT, T5, RoBERTa) for domain-specific tasks
Design and iterate on prompt engineering strategies including CoT, zero-shot, and few-shot
Build and maintain production NLP pipelines for text generation, summarisation, and classification
Research and evaluate emerging LLM architectures and capabilities
Collaborate with product teams to integrate AI capabilities into applications
Conduct model evaluation, bias analysis, and performance optimisation
7+ years overall with 2+ years focused on transformer-based LLM work
Expertise in GPT, BERT, T5, RoBERTa architectures and attention mechanisms
Proficiency in Python and NLP libraries (Hugging Face, SpaCy, NLTK)
Experience with fine-tuning, instruction tuning, and RLHF techniques
Strong understanding of prompting: CoT, zero-shot, few-shot, prompt templates
Experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex
Knowledge of model quantisation and deployment
